The condition reduces to: some placement of A and B makes the union of their black cells exactly equal to X's black pattern, with every black cell inside the H_X×W_X window. Three cases are the most delicate: test 4 (A's pair can't fit in X's non-adjacent pattern), test 6 (rotation is not allowed), and test 10 (the union can have at most 3 cells, so it can't cover all 4 cells of X).
